standard.title: JVM Artifact Publication
standard.summary: Maven and Gradle publications preserve upstream companion files and bind source archives and module metadata to the exact patched release.
applies-to: Maven and Gradle package patch providers

requirements.override-explanation: Specializes the parent's required upstream-preserving inventory with Maven classifiers, POM packaging and Gradle module metadata, retaining required files and checksum verification.
requirements.text: Maven/Gradle releases must preserve the upstream baseline publication's file roles and classifiers and include a POM, the primary artifact where packaging is not pom, and sources JARs, javadoc JARs and Gradle module metadata wherever upstream published them, with the required checksums. Additional companion artifacts are optional and must pass applicable checks when supplied.

checks.override-explanation: Applies the parent's upstream inventory and checksum check to Maven packaging, classifiers and Gradle metadata while preserving every required upstream counterpart.
checks.title: Maven and Gradle publication inventory is complete

requirements.text: Every source-archive entry mapped to a tracked file must match its bytes at the patched release tag; build-added entries must be individually listed with their origin and must not mask tracked-source mismatches.

checks.title: Source archive entries match the patched tag or are listed build additions

requirements.text: Every Gradle module file reference must resolve to the exact release file promoted for that variant, with matching name, byte size and SHA-256.

checks.title: Gradle module metadata identifies the exact promoted variant files
